name: Factory Night Shift Log
description: A handwritten note from the quarantined town.
readingText:
Night Shift — Personal Remarks

22:40 — Pressure dropped in the lower pipes.

23:15 — Knocking reported behind the sealed boiler-room wall.

23:22 — Supervisor ordered us to ignore it.

00:06 — Knocking resumed. Three knocks, then two.

00:11 — Mikhail answered by striking the pipe with his wrench.

00:12 — Something struck back.

Mikhail didn't come to work today.

The supervisor says he was transferred. His coat is still hanging beside mine.
